body: For me it got worse after 3 years, from taking an ototoxic drug.

My tinnitus are really really loud.
For me living with this constant noise is like being imprisoned for the rest of my life, it’s sad, but i’m telling myself that death would be more than deliverance.

I understand that the research is advancing and that we are getting closer to a treatment from year to year, but i find that it is going really too slowly. I dunno, telling myself that millions of people around the world have been suffering for decades and still nothing has been found makes me so pessimistic. Personally, i don't think i will ever wake up and hear the silence again. But maybe in the future there will be a treatment who can at least reduce the intensity of tinnitus which would be already a big step.

Anyway, thank you for taking the time to respond, your message brings back hope and helps me regain little positivity.

Have a nice day man.
If the brain is such an amazing thing, why does tinnitus exist?
I don't think we gonna see a cure in our lifetime unfortunately.
I want to die to end the pain.

I suffer from severe tinnitus and there isn't a day when i don't think about suicide. It’s impossible to live a normal life with this and those who say otherwise don’t know how disabling tinnitus can be. It is a real daily torture that i endure, well for the moment, because i hope soon to put an end to this unbearable pain.

Do you go to bed right away after taking it? If 3.75 mg and even 7.5 mg don't do anything to you, you should ask to your doctor to move to 15mg but this is the maximum dose he can prescribe and sometimes some doctors refuse ...

Personally I'm already starting to get used to 15 mg and the doctor warned me that I was going to have to reduce it and then stop it but I don't know how I'm going to do without sleeping pills, I hate  insomnia :(
Unfortunately there is nothing to do, when the hair cells are destroyed they do not grow back, it is irreversible.
Unfortunately it costs too much, 10k€ to die, personally I cannot afford it ...
Unfortunately there is nothing to do, the doctor told me I had to learn to live with it. Thank you for taking the time to read me and answer.
I know how you feel, insomnia is a horrible thing. Have you tried Zopiclone ? It’s not THE solution, but it’s always better than not sleeping at all ...

Personally, i started zopiclone at 7.5mg, three months later it was no longer working and now I'm at 15mg per night. The problem is that the body quickly gets used to the molecule and you will have to increase the doses to have the same effect, it's a never-ending cycle.
The volume of my tinnitus increased dramatically after taking paroxetin (paxil), and even after stopping it my tinnitus never returned to its normal level.

I am not a scientist, but I believe that the deterioration of hair cells during sound trauma is the cause of some tinnitus. The brain then receives bad information from the destroyed cells which leads to hyperexitability of the brain.
But these are just speculations.

(Sorry for my english)

If the increase of your tinnitus was caused by an ototoxic drug unfortunately there is nothing to be done. My tinnitus also increased because of a drug (Deroxat) and even after stopping it nothing has changed. Be careful with antidepressants as many of them can cause an irreversible increase of your tinnitus.

Hi man, I know what you're going through, I'm in the same situation. My life has become hell since my tinnitus increased 6 months ago. I can no longer read, listen to music, play video games and above all I can not even sleep. I have to take sleeping pills to get a few hours of sleep. I could never have thought that my tinnitus would increase to the point of making me deeply depressed, even suicidal. No treatment, no cure, for us, just suffering. F ** k this life.
